2. In this Ordinance—

1. This Ordinance may | cited as the Girl Guides
"Association" means the Federation of Malaya
Branch of the Girl Guides Association incorporated
under the Royal Charter granted on the Fourteenth

Day of December, 1922;

"Guide" includes a Brownie, Guide, Ranger, Cadet
or Lay Member of the |Girl Guides Association,
recognised as such by the| Rules of the Girl Guides
Association as amended for use by the Federation of
Malaya Branch of the _ Association.

3. (1) The person for the time being discharging the
duties of Chief Commissioner of the Association, and
her successors in office, shall be a body corporate,
under the name of the ‘jChief Commissioner, Girl
Guides Association, Federation of Malaya Branch", in
this Ordinance called the "corporation".

(2) The corporation may enter into contracts and may
sue and be sued in its said name and shall have
perpetual succession and a corporate seal, and the said
seal may from time to time be broken, changed, altered
and made anew as to the corporation seems fit; and until
a seal is provided under this|section a stamp, bearing the
inscription "Chief Commissioner, Girl Guides Associa-
tion, Federation of Malaya Branch", may be used as the
corporate seal.

(3) The Corporation may acquire, purchase, take,
hold and enjoy movable and immovable property of
every description, and may sell, convey, assign,

GIRL GUIDES                        469

surrender and yield up, charge, mortgage, demise,
reassign, transfer or otherwise dispose of, or deal with,
any movable or immovable property vested in the said
corporation upon such terms as to the corporation
seems fit.

4. All deeds, documents |and other instruments
requiring the seal of the corporation shall be sealed
with the seal of the corporation in the presence of the
person for the time being discharging the duties of
Chief Commissioner of the Association, who shall sign
every such deed, document}or other instrument to
which the corporate seal is affixed, and such signing
shall be sufficient evidence that the said seal was duly
and properly affixed and that the same is the lawful
seal of the corporation.

5. A notification in the Gazette of the appointment
of any person to hold, or act in, the office of Chief
Commissioner of the Association shall be conclusive
evidence that such person was ‘duly so appointed.

6. No person, other than the Association, shall sell
or expose for sale any badge, token or emblem
specifically adopted for use by a Guide under the Rules
of the Association, except that such badges, tokens or
emblems may be sold or exposed for sale by a person
authorised in writing so to do by the Chief Commis-
sioner of the Association.

7. No person, not being a Guide, shall publicly wear,
carry or bear in such a manner as to convey the
impression that such person} is a Guide any badge,
token or emblem specifically adopted for use by a
Guide under the Rules of the Association.

8. No person shall without lawful authority or excuse
have in his possession—

(a) any device which sp closely resembles any
badge, token or emblem specifically adopted
for use by a Guide under the Rules of the
Association as to lead to the belief that the
device in question |is such badge, token or
emblem; or

(b) any badge, token or| emblem containing any
words or characters so closely resembling
any words or characters ordinarily used to
describe any Guide as to be calculated to
deceive or mislead;| or
